:= by
  have h_sum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico m n, x ^ i = (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) :=
    by rw [Finset.sum_Ico, Finset.sum_const, Finset.sum_const, Nat.sum_pow]
  have h_xn_nonneg : 0 ≤ x ^ n :=
    by induction' n with d hd; rw [Nat.pow_zero, zero_le_one]; exact (hx.trans (pow_nonneg hx))
  have h_xn_le_one : x ^ n ≤ 1 :=
    by induction' n with d hd; rw [Nat.pow_zero, zero_le_one]; exact (h'x.pow n).trans_le (one_le_one)
  have h_bound : (x ^ m - x ^ n) / (1 - x) ≤ x ^ m / (1 - x) :=
    by rw [sub_le_iff_add_nonneg_right, add_le_iff, le_add_iff_left]
      exact (le_add_right (x ^ m) (x ^ n)).trans (le_add_right (x ^ m) (x ^ n))
  rw [h_sum]
  exact h_bound
